text:
## Core Domains  
1. **Party & Customer Domain** — People and organizations interacting with the bank
2. **Product Domain** — Banking products and services
3. **Account Domain** — Customer accounts and holdings
4. **Transaction Domain** — Money movement and account activity
5. **Risk & Compliance Domain** — Regulatory and risk concepts
6. **Organization Domain** — Organizational structure and roles

raw_entities.name: Party
raw_entities.description: A foundational domain entity representing people and organizations that interact with the bank. Parties form the basis of the Party & Customer Domain within FirstUK Bank's business ontology.
context: Party & Customer Domain — People and organizations interacting with the bank

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: A core domain entity within the Party & Customer Domain representing individuals or entities that hold banking relationships with FirstUK Bank. Customers are central to account, product, and transaction management.
context: Party & Customer Domain — People and organizations interacting with the bank

raw_entities.name: Product
raw_entities.description: A core domain entity representing banking products and services offered by FirstUK Bank. Products form the conceptual foundation of the Product Domain.
context: Product Domain — Banking products and services

raw_entities.name: Account
raw_entities.description: A core domain entity representing customer accounts and holdings within FirstUK Bank. Accounts are the primary vehicle through which customers interact with banking products and services.
context: Account Domain — Customer accounts and holdings

raw_entities.name: Transaction
raw_entities.description: A core domain entity representing money movement and account activity. Transactions capture all financial events occurring on customer accounts within FirstUK Bank.
context: Transaction Domain — Money movement and account activity

raw_entities.name: Risk & Compliance Concept
raw_entities.description: A foundational domain entity encompassing regulatory and risk concepts that govern FirstUK Bank's operations. This domain includes AML screening, KYC verification, SAR filing, and fraud detection obligations.
context: Risk & Compliance Domain — Regulatory and risk concepts

raw_entities.name: Organization
raw_entities.description: The organizational structure and roles domain within FirstUK Bank's business ontology. This domain defines how the bank is structured and how roles and responsibilities are distributed.
context: Organization Domain — Organizational structure and roles
